name: Ever After
tagline: A wedding planner for Android: countdown, checklist, budget, guests and vendors in one place.
description:
Ever After is a wedding planner for Android. It brings the countdown to your wedding day, your checklist, budget, guest list and vendor list together in one place, styled like a letterpress stationery set.

Pick your wedding colours from eight schemes or choose your own, and use the app in light mode, dark mode or following your phone. Everything you enter is stored on your phone. There is no account to create.

Ever After is free with a small banner ad. A one-time "Remove ads" purchase turns the ads off.
features: Countdown to the wedding day
Wedding checklist with a starter list of tasks
Budget with expenses
Guest list and vendor list
Eight wedding colour schemes, or your own colour
Light and dark appearance
Available in 19 languages
Data stays on your phone, no account needed

screenshots.alt: The home screen in another colour scheme

tech: Kotlin: the whole app, with Jetpack Compose and Material 3 for the interface
Compose Canvas: custom drawing for the letterpress look (ruled lines, stamps, pen ticks)
On-device storage: everything saved as JSON files on the phone, with no server and no account
Google AdMob: a small banner ad, with the User Messaging Platform for GDPR consent
Google Play Billing: the one-time "Remove ads" purchase
Google Play In-App Review: an occasional request for a rating
Localisation: English plus 18 translations, with a per-app language setting on Android 13+
Android 8.0 (API 26) and newer, built with Gradle and shrunk with R8

name: Kvit og frit
tagline: A receipt and warranty keeper for Android: scan a receipt and get a reminder before the warranty or return window runs out.
description:
Kvit og frit keeps your receipts and warranties in one place, styled like a till slip. Scan a receipt and the app reads the shop, date, total and items on your phone, then reminds you before the warranty or the return window ends.

Bought a present? Send the receipt by text message or email, so they can exchange it themselves. At the shop counter, the receipt and its barcode are shown full screen, together with a short guide to your rights as a consumer in your country.

Everything is stored on your phone. There is no account to create.

Kvit og frit is under development and not yet on Google Play. Features may change before it is released.
features: Scan receipts; the shop, date, total and items are read on your phone
Reminders before a warranty or return period ends
Several items and categories on one receipt
Send a receipt to someone, or save one you received
The receipt and its barcode full screen at the counter
Consumer rights for your country
Backup to a file you choose, and moving to a new phone
Available in 19 languages, with any currency
Data stays on your phone, no account needed

name: Regnorm
tagline: A plant care app for Android that waters by the weather: it follows the rain, sun and frost where your garden is.
description:
Regnorm keeps track of your plants, outside and inside. For the garden it reads the weather where your garden is and works out, plant by plant, when the soil is getting dry, so you don't water after a day of rain. In Denmark the weather comes from the Danish Meteorological Institute (DMI); elsewhere from MET Norway, with Regnorm estimating what that forecast doesn't measure. Houseplants follow a watering schedule that slows down in winter.

A worm in a speech bubble tells you what needs doing. On frozen days a snowflake replaces the water drop, and the worm warns you before a frost night. Bring a plant indoors for the winter or for good, and Regnorm switches to resting care and nudges you when spring comes. You can also track how tall your plants grow, note pot sizes, and see what to sow, plant and harvest each month.

Your plants stay on your phone, with no account to create. If you like, you can share a garden with your family using an invite code, so everyone sees what has been watered.

Regnorm is in testing and not yet on Google Play. Features may change before it is released.
features: Watering by the weather for garden plants: DMI in Denmark, MET Norway elsewhere
Watering schedules for houseplants, gentler in winter
A snowflake on frozen days, and frost warnings for plants that can't take it
Move plants indoors for the season or for good, with frost and spring nudges
147 plants to pick from, from house plants to fruit trees and berries
Plant heights and pot sizes, with repotting suggestions
A garden calendar for sowing, planting, feeding and harvest
Share a garden with family through an invite code, no account needed
An optional morning reminder
Available in 20 languages

tech: Kotlin: the whole app, with Jetpack Compose and Material 3 for the interface
DMI open data API: weather forecasts (HARMONIE model) and climate data from the Danish Meteorological Institute, CC BY 4.0
MET Norway Locationforecast: weather outside Denmark, CC BY 4.0, with evaporation and sunshine estimated in the app
Location: the weather is fetched for where your garden is, using a rounded position
Firebase Firestore with anonymous sign-in: optional garden sharing, with no account
AlarmManager and notifications: a daily watering reminder
Home-screen widget: today's watering, frost and tasks (Regnorm Plus)
Built-in plant catalogue: a CSV file of plants and their care needs
On-device storage: plants, photos and settings saved on the phone
Google AdMob: a small banner ad, with the User Messaging Platform for GDPR consent
Google Play Billing: the one-time Regnorm Plus purchase, which removes the ad and adds photos, your own plants, the widget and outfits for the worm
Localisation: English plus 19 translations, with a per-app language setting on Android 13+
Android 8.0 (API 26) and newer, built with Gradle and shrunk with R8
